'''Aedalus''' was a tame [[Convor/Legends|convor]] from the jungle [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], it was offered for sale as a pet by the [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|vendor droid]] [[80-T5]], who ran a stall in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Aedalus had [[Color/Legends|gray]] and yellow feathers and yellow skin, with black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="CWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Straight from the jungles of Wasskah to you, this Convor will be a faithful companion as you travel the galaxy!|Store Description|<ref name="CWA" />}}
Aedalus first appeared as a purchasable companion for players in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] released by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment in [[2010]]<ref name="CWA" /> and shut down in [[2014]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{WebCite|url=https://www.clonewarsadventures.com/news/detail.action?articleId=1589|text=With Heavy Hearts, We Announce the Sunset of Clone Wars|author=George, Steve|date=01/24/2014|archivedate=20140314072821}}</ref> The convor could be bought for 350 station cash, a premium in-game currency players had to buy with real money. Given that Aedalus's purchase was entirely optional, this article makes no assumptions about if it was bought.<ref name="CWA" />
